reviewer: Codex explicit raw-inventory, source, ordered-failure and consumer review

formal_specification.domain: Raw mutable literal metadata. Required fields and every selected inventory component are nonempty byte strings; whitespace/Unicode/NUL and arbitrary nonempty labels are permitted. Empty inventories are permitted. No referential integrity, totality, monotonicity, naturality, adjoint, commutative-square or lifting law is admitted.
formal_specification.construction: Constructors/setters store raw data without mathematical admission. Vec append or list replacement preserves the declared input order; raw flags remain declarations. Serde remains raw transport.
formal_specification.acceptance: All ordered required fields and all ordered selected entry components satisfy nonemptiness. Other fields remain unconstrained declarations. Success returns unit only.
formal_specification.failure: First required-label failure then first invalid collection/entry returns existing typed InvalidShape with its exact specified diagnostic. For maps iteration is BTreeMap key order; the shared entry diagnostic does not claim a numeric insertion index. No validation mutation or partial admitted artifact.
formal_specification.specific_operation: No operation beyond the mapped raw data construction/assignment and literal inventory validation.

FiberedCategoryShell::validate_shell.body: { if self.label.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty label".into())); } if self.total_label.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty total_label".into())); } if self.base_label.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty base_label".into())); } for (i, (b, f)) in self.fibers.iter().enumerate() { if b.is_empty() || f.is_empty() { return Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape(format!("empty fiber entry at index {i}"))); } } Ok(()) }

invariant_argument: Flatten required literal labels then each selected collection/component in source order. The first empty String returns its exact typed diagnostic without mutation. Constructors/setters are raw data; no law is admitted.

Flatten individual nonempty String checks into the unchanged ordered-predicate model, giving every component of one entry the same diagnostic. The OR-of-empty condition is the complement of the required conjunction. success_iff/first_error_preserved apply to any finite inventory, including empty lists. This is source-reviewed correspondence, not extracted Rust/MIR.

Borrowed iter()/enumerate() yields actual bounded entries; no mutable validation, unchecked indexing or numeric conversion occurs. The prefix invariant extends on a valid entry and exits at the first violation. All 42 public production methods in this twelve-file batch have owner-qualified body maps.
Raw constructors, field/list replacement, append and flag defaults do not construct an admitted mathematical wrapper. Standard String/Vec/conversion/allocator contracts remain explicit dependencies.

failure_paths.required_labels: First literal empty field, exact InvalidShape(empty FIELD).
failure_paths.inventory: First invalid component of the first invalid entry, in the stated collection order. Entry components share the policy diagnostic, so no stronger component-name claim is made.
failure_paths.raw_transport: Derived serde may construct rejected raw candidates, which must still call validate_shell. No admitted wrapper exists in these modules.
failure_paths.runtime: Validation performs no user callback, rational arithmetic, narrowing cast, partial index or mutable operation. Standard String/&str constructor conversions, arbitrary caller Into implementations and allocator behavior remain the ordinary external runtime boundary.

trust_boundary.model: Unchanged kernel-checked ordered finite String-predicate/refusal model with standard foundational axioms. Dynamic inventory-to-list relation and runtime enumeration are source reviewed.
trust_boundary.runtime: Pinned safe Rust/std, actual crate errors::ArithmosError via the canonical self-alias, serde derives and standard allocator/conversion contracts.
trust_boundary.adapter: Only OppositeCategoryShell requires a parent category import adapter for the actual current MorphismTriple provider; no provider algorithm is cloned. Typed InvalidShape comes from the canonical category self-alias or that same real crate in challenge namespaces.

consumer_review: Current hierarchy re-exports are replayed through canonical public TypeId controls and all 107 export faults; the unchanged 459-test actual category suite passes before/after the current batch. The error-carrier change is deliberate and preserves predicate/payload order.

The retained qualified lexical Rust-src inventory distinguishes overloaded raw Functor/Function/Set names; it is a call-site aid, not an external or whole-workspace compatibility attestation. Raw metadata does not acquire a consumer category law.

G1: Source SHA, complete public-symbol mapping, independent required-field/entry schema and diagnostics, explicit provider/crate pins and current runtime/dependency receipts bind the limited claim. Original sources and the error-carrier-only delta are retained; AuthorityEffect is None.
G2: Literal labels, entry components and first-error ordering agree with the declared schema. Raw flags and optional references remain declarations; no fibration, category, functor, naturality or total-function law is inferred. Arbitrary nonempty strings remain literal data, without normalization or hidden referential constraints.
G3: The checked ordered-predicate model plus the explicit source/iterator relation covers each validation return and data preservation. Each loop has a finite collection bound and borrows without mutation. Typed diagnostics propagate directly; constructors/setters emit raw candidates and retain the declared standard conversion/allocator boundary.
G4: 107 independent schema cases cross label masks and every component emptiness subset with first/middle/last and multiple-invalid positions. Distinct constructors, raw flags and list bindings are checked independently. All 14 valid single-fault candidates for this file compile and are killed in their own namespace.

The final twelve-file campaign has 156 kills, zero other outcomes, 60 unmutated local/challenge tests and 459 actual category tests before/after. Every source, helper, policy, tool/dependency and log pin is retained. Shared compilation is disclosed; no compiler failure or unrun candidate counts as a kill.
G5: Finite loops, one visit per entry, O(1) String byte-length tests per component and one diagnostic allocation at first refusal. Move-based constructors, finite Vec append/replacement and no recursion or unchecked production indexing. Opposite maps each owned triple once; Set length observes Vec::len exactly.

Calibrated source AST ceilings are separately enforced. All bodies and iterator closures are mapped; standard serde/collection internals are pinned trusted libraries, not silently treated as expanded compiler proof.

assurance_limits: Capability remains L2 raw metadata and literal data operations; named mathematical objects are not admitted by these shape checks.
